title: 2026 Family Trip: Rome
party: Calvin & wife · kids 9, 7, 5, 2, 8 months · sister & brother-in-law · 9 people

flights.out: Sun Nov 15 · AZ 619 · IAD 4:30pm → FCO 7:00am Mon

audience.pickup: Bronze Door (Portone di Bronzo), Apostolic Palace, Piazza San Pietro, right colonnade
audience.pickupWindows: Tue Nov 17: 8:30am–1:00pm and 3:00pm–7:00pm · Wed Nov 18 from 7:30am

open: Colosseum timed tickets for Fri Nov 20 (~30 days out)
Anniversary table at Glass Hostaria or L’Arcangelo
Call ahead for tables of 9 (may need two tables) — every sit-down lunch/dinner is a different place this week
Optional Vatican Museums for older kids

days.label: Travel
days.title: Sunday Nov 15 — Travel day
days.note: Not in Rome. Dulles evening departure.

blocks.what: Washington Dulles (IAD) · Be at the airport with margin for nine people and a stroller. Flight AZ 619 departs 4:30pm.
Nonstop to Rome · ~8h 30m · lands next morning

days.label: Arrive
days.title: Monday Nov 16 — Arrive & first walk
days.note: Goal: get the apartment, eat, then stay out for an easy Vatican-side evening. Arrival quiet time is only for check-in and jet lag—not a sightseeing nap cycle.

blocks.what: Fiumicino (FCO) · Land on AZ 619. Immigration and bags for nine: plan 45–90 minutes.
Pre-booked van or 2–3 taxis · FCO → Prati · ~35–60 min. Skip the train with this group today.

Check in, unpack cribs, find bathrooms, start laundry. First grocery shop: Despar at Viale Giulio Cesare 193 (near Ottaviano) and/or Mercato Rionale Prati in Piazza dell’Unità. Pharmacy on Via Cola di Rienzo if needed.
blocks.label: Prati apartment

blocks.what: Showers, change clothes, short quiet sit at the apartment while bags get sorted.
Light first meal at the Prati Airbnb from the grocery run — keep it simple after the overnight flight. Skip a restaurant lunch today. Draft — not a booking.
blocks.label: Apartment lunch

blocks.what: Apartment → St Peter’s Square · ~20–30 min family pace.

St Peter’s Square · Colonnade, façade, obelisk. If energy is good, enter the basilica (daily 7:00am–8:00pm, last entry 7:15pm; free). Keep it short on day one. Summary: first look at the heart of the pilgrimage—stand in the Square, step inside if kids are willing, don’t climb the dome today.
Café sit near the Square / Borgo · snacks, bathroom, stroller reset.
Slow walk along Via della Conciliazione and toward Castel Sant’Angelo bridge for photos. Optional exterior only of Castel Sant’Angelo—save the museum for later if anyone still wants it.
Walk back to Prati · 20–30 min.
Light landing-night meal at the apartment from groceries. Don’t overload with a big trattoria the night you land. Draft — not a booking.
blocks.label: Apartment dinner

blocks.what: Kids to bed. Jet lag night.

days.label: Centro
days.title: Tuesday Nov 17 — Centro Storico
days.note: Full day in the center: Pantheon → Minerva → San Luigi → lunch → Trevi → Spanish Steps. End the afternoon at the Vatican Bronze Door to pick up Wednesday’s audience tickets (open 3:00–7:00pm the day before). Timed Pantheon tickets when November inventory opens.

blocks.what: At the Prati Airbnb after the grocery shop. Groceries for apartment breakfasts: Despar (Viale Giulio Cesare 193, near Ottaviano) and/or Mercato Rionale Prati (Piazza dell’Unità). First shop on arrival Mon Nov 16 after check-in. Draft routine — not a café reservation. Pack snacks, water, diapers.
blocks.label: Apartment breakfast

blocks.what: Metro A Ottaviano → Spagna or Barberini, then walk · ~30–45 min door to door. Taxi if lifts fail.
Arrive Pantheon area · bathroom · ticket check.

Pantheon (Santa Maria ad Martyres) · Open 9:00am–7:00pm (last entry 6:30pm). Timed tickets via Musei Italiani; under-18 free but still need a ticket. Summary: one vast round hall with an open roof—kids look up, adults get the wow, then you leave.
Walk to Minerva · ~5–10 min.

Via degli Orfani 84, next to the Pantheon (two minutes from Piazza della Minerva). Historic Roman espresso bar — stand at the counter with a cornetto while you wait for Minerva to open. Bernini’s elephant-obelisk is in the piazza. Draft — not a reservation.
blocks.label: Coffee — Tazza d’Oro

blocks.what: Santa Maria sopra Minerva · Gothic basilica; Michelangelo’s Christ; St Catherine’s tomb. Calm 20–30 minutes. Free. Hours conflict across sources—verify that morning.
Walk to San Luigi dei Francesi · ~5–10 min.
San Luigi dei Francesi · Mon–Fri 9:30am–12:45pm & 2:30–6:15pm. Contarelli Chapel: Caravaggio’s three St Matthew paintings. Free. Be out before the midday close.

Vicolo della Campana 18/20, between the Pantheon and Piazza Navona. Historic Roman pasta house (from 1518) on a side street, not a piazza tourist trap, and large enough for a family of 9. Closed Monday; Tuesday is open. Call ahead for 9 / may need two tables. Draft suggestion — not reserved. Armando al Pantheon is excellent but they do not take groups over 6, so it is not the pick for nine.
blocks.label: La Campana

blocks.what: Walk toward Trevi · ~15–25 min.
Trevi Fountain · Street view free anytime. Inner basin controlled entry (€2 non-residents under Feb 2026 rules; free under 6). Quick coin toss / photos. Crowded—don’t linger.

Via Uffici del Vicario 40 — a short walk from Trevi toward the Pantheon/Parliament side. Historic Roman gelateria, not a piazza souvenir stand. Pay at the cassa first, then take the ticket to the counter. Draft — not a reservation.
blocks.label: Gelato — Giolitti

blocks.what: Walk to Spanish Steps / Piazza di Spagna · ~15–20 min.
Spanish Steps & Trinità dei Monti · Climb if older kids want; otherwise enjoy the piazza from below. Church at the top optional. Bathroom break here before the ride to the Bronze Door.
blocks.label: Spanish Steps

blocks.what: Taxi or Metro toward St Peter’s / Prati side · ~25–40 min. Aim to reach the Bronze Door during the afternoon pickup window.

Bronze Door (Portone di Bronzo) · Apostolic Palace, Piazza San Pietro, right colonnade. Collect all 9 General Audience tickets. Reservation 1113_UG_18.11/2026. Day-before window: 3:00–7:00pm (also 8:30am–1:00pm). Bring the confirmation email / reservation number. If you miss this, pick up Wed from 7:30am.
Short walk back to the Prati apartment · ~15–25 min.

Via dei Gracchi 55, Prati. Neighborhood Roman pasta trattoria — not a laminated piazza menu. Official winter schedule: closed Wednesday (lunch and dinner) and Sunday dinner. Use tonight only — they are closed Wednesday. Call ahead for 9 / may need two tables. Draft suggestion — not reserved. Early bedtime; audience morning starts early.
blocks.label: Il Matriciano

blocks.what: Bedtime. Put tickets and passports with tomorrow’s bag.

days.label: Audience
days.title: Wednesday Nov 18 — Vatican day · Papal audience
days.note: Audience confirmed: General Audience 10:00am, Wed Nov 18, 2026 · 9 tickets · reservation 1113_UG_18.11/2026. Tickets should already be in hand from Tuesday’s Bronze Door pickup (backup: collect Wed from 7:30am). Walk from Prati. Afternoon stays on the Vatican/Borgo side.

blocks.what: At the Prati Airbnb after the grocery shop. Groceries for apartment breakfasts: Despar (Viale Giulio Cesare 193, near Ottaviano) and/or Mercato Rionale Prati (Piazza dell’Unità). First shop on arrival Mon Nov 16 after check-in. Draft routine — not a café reservation. Modest dress for the audience. Bring reservation 1113_UG_18.11/2026 and all 9 tickets (or collect at the Bronze Door from 7:30am if not picked up Tuesday).
blocks.label: Apartment breakfast

blocks.what: Apartment → St Peter’s Square / Bronze Door · 20–30 min. Allow security and seating time; with nine people and a stroller, arrive early.

Bronze Door backup only · If tickets were not collected Tuesday: Portone di Bronzo, Apostolic Palace, right colonnade, from 7:30am. Reservation 1113_UG_18.11/2026, 9 tickets. Skip this block if tickets are already in hand—go straight into the Square.
Enter security, find seats in St Peter’s Square or the hall as directed. Bathroom before it starts. Kids snacks OK while you wait.

Papal General Audience · Confirmed 10:00am, Wed Nov 18, 2026 · free · reservation 1113_UG_18.11/2026 · 9 places. Readings and blessing; the Pope often greets the crowd. Summary: the pilgrimage highlight of the week—sit through the audience together, then exit calmly with the stroller.
Snack / bathroom at the edge of the Square after the crowd thins a bit.

St Peter’s Basilica · Free entry. Pietà, baldachin, nave; crypt if the group can. Skip the dome with the baby and toddler. Modest dress. Summary: the pilgrimage centerpiece—pray and look; don’t try to finish every corner.

Via Andrea Doria 55 a/b, Prati. Neighborhood trattoria-pizzeria since 1936, walkable after the audience (closer than crossing the city). Closed Monday; Wednesday is open. Call ahead for 9 / may need two tables. Draft suggestion — not reserved. Not Il Matriciano — closed Wednesday.
blocks.label: Trattoria Micci

blocks.what: Post-lunch sit. Optional: only the older kids + one adult do Vatican Museums / Sistine with a timed ticket from museivaticani.va (weekday only). Rest of the group skips.

Castel Sant’Angelo · Tue–Sun 9:00am–7:30pm, closed Mon. Named tickets recommended. Castle ramps, courtyards, rooftop views. Lots of stairs—use judgment with the stroller; exterior + bridge is enough if the museum is too much. Summary: Hadrian’s tomb turned fortress—“castle day” for the 5–9s.
Walk back toward Prati along the river or Via dei Gracchi · ~15–20 min to the gelateria.

Via dei Gracchi 272, Prati — on the walk home from Castel Sant’Angelo. Artisanal gelato (pistachio and classic flavors), not a tourist-strip shop. Official listing: daily 11:30–midnight. Draft — not a reservation.
blocks.label: Gelato — dei Gracchi

blocks.what: Via dei Gracchi 19, Prati. Neighborhood osteria with Roman pasta near Ottaviano. Call ahead for 9 / may need two tables. Draft suggestion — not reserved. Il Matriciano is closed Wednesday.
blocks.label: Osteria dei Gracchi

blocks.what: Quiet evening.

days.label: Anniversary
days.title: Thursday Nov 19 — Light day · 10th anniversary
days.note: Easy morning nearby. Afternoon free in Prati / river. Kids pizza with aunt and uncle; parents’ anniversary dinner. No table held yet. Evening details:

blocks.what: At the Prati Airbnb after the grocery shop. Groceries for apartment breakfasts: Despar (Viale Giulio Cesare 193, near Ottaviano) and/or Mercato Rionale Prati (Piazza dell’Unità). First shop on arrival Mon Nov 16 after check-in. Draft routine — not a café reservation. Unhurried.
blocks.label: Apartment breakfast

blocks.what: Short walk in Prati to a nearby church or playground · 10–20 min.

Via Fabio Massimo 1/A, Prati. Historic neighborhood caffè from 1919 — cornetto and espresso at the bar, then a short playground or church walk. Not a piazza tourist table. Confirm morning hours nearer the trip. Draft — not a reservation.
blocks.label: Coffee — Sciascia 1919

blocks.what: Neighborhood church / park time after coffee. Keep it local — no long metro.
Apartment free play, laundry, grocery top-up. Adults prep date-night clothes. Taxi to Piazza Sallustio around 11:40 for lunch.

Piazza Sallustio 12, Sallustiano (short taxi from Prati, behind Via Veneto — not a tourist piazza). Family-run osteria of Roman and Marchigiana cooking. Official site: closed Sunday; Thursday is open. Call ahead for 9 / may need two tables. Draft suggestion — not reserved.
blocks.label: Cantina Cantarini

blocks.what: Taxi back to Prati. Easy afternoon: Via Cola di Rienzo, playground, or river walk. Stay close so the evening handoff is simple.

Via della Meloria 43, Prati (Cipro). Gabriele Bonci’s pizza al taglio — long-leavened slices sold by weight, plus supplì. Standing counter and a queue; the group of 9 may need to split and eat outside. A few slices to share, not a second lunch (kids have sit-down pizza later). Official Bonci page: Mon–Sat 11:00–22:00. Draft — not a reservation.
blocks.label: Pizza al taglio — Pizzarium

blocks.what: Kids eat early with aunt and uncle. Via degli Scipioni 248/250, Prati — neighborhood Roman pizzeria (tonda), not a piazza tourist trap. Hour listings disagree (some say from 12:30 weekdays, others from 17:30); call to confirm an early family table. Call ahead for a larger table / may need two tables. Draft suggestion — not reserved. Parents may not join sit-down if getting ready for anniversary dinner.
blocks.label: La Pratolina

blocks.what: Babysitting handoff at the apartment ~17:30–18:30. Written bedtime order for 9y/7y/5y/2y/8mo, bottles/diapers location, Wi‑Fi + door code once known, WhatsApp live location. Quiet evening at the apartment — no outing after parents leave. Parents’ return window ~21:30–22:30 if Glass.
Taxi Prati → Trastevere · ~15–25 min. Leave ~18:30–18:45 for a ~19:00–19:30 seating at Glass. Skip this taxi if they choose L’Arcangelo (walkable in Prati).

Vicolo del Cinque 58, Trastevere. Anniversary dinner for Calvin and his wife (party of 2). Modern tasting-menu room, not a piazza tourist table. Site hours: closed Mon/Tue; Wed–Sun dinner ~19:00–22:30. Tasting menu listed on their site at €135/person drinks excluded (from their menu page — recheck before booking). Nov 19 2026 is Thursday → within the Wed–Sun dinner window. Draft suggestion — nothing reserved. Book only via official OpenTable / TheFork links on glasshostaria.it. Alternate: L’Arcangelo, Via Giuseppe Gioachino Belli 59, Prati (walkable; lunch 13:00–14:30, dinner 20:00–23:00, Saturday dinner only, closed Sunday).
blocks.label: Glass Hostaria

blocks.what: Taxi back to Prati · 15–25 min. Parents’ return window ~21:30–22:30 if Glass.
Relieve babysitters. Quiet apartment night for the kids — no outing after handoff.

days.label: Colosseum
days.title: Friday Nov 20 — Colosseum & Forum
days.note: Winter hours: Colosseum 8:30am; Forum–Palatine 9:00am; last entry 3:30pm; closes 4:30pm (25 Oct 2026–28 Feb 2027). Book all nine ~30 days ahead. Skip arena and underground. Afternoon gelato in Monti, then Testaccio for street food and a pasta dinner — no midday home break.

blocks.what: At the Prati Airbnb after the grocery shop. Groceries for apartment breakfasts: Despar (Viale Giulio Cesare 193, near Ottaviano) and/or Mercato Rionale Prati (Piazza dell’Unità). First shop on arrival Mon Nov 16 after check-in. Draft routine — not a café reservation. Water and snacks for the Forum.
blocks.label: Apartment breakfast

blocks.what: Metro A → Termini → Metro B Colosseo · ~35–50 min. Target an 8:30 or 9:00 Colosseum slot.
Colosseum · Book at ticketing.colosseo.it. Standard tiers—not arena/underground. Under-18 free tickets must still be reserved; bring IDs. Summary: walk the amphitheatre, keep moving before legs quit.
Arch of Constantine · Free exterior stop. Quick photos.
Walk to Forum gate · ~10–15 min.
Roman Forum · Combined ticket area. Uneven stones—carrier often better than stroller. Main street and arches; skip deep Palatine unless older kids insist. Last entry 3:30pm.

Via dei Serpenti 113, Monti — Roman osteria cooking a short walk from the Colosseum, not a Via dei Fori laminated-menu strip. Long sit; rest feet. Call ahead for 9 / may need two tables. Draft suggestion — not reserved. Alternate: Osteria Al Vicolo 9, Vicolo dei Serpenti 9 (closed Sunday; Friday is open).
blocks.label: Dar Bruttone Rione Monti

blocks.what: Piazza degli Zingari 5, Monti — a few minutes from Via dei Serpenti. Artisanal gelato (fruit sorbets and unusual flavors), not a Colosseum-front souvenir shop. Listings: Fri 13:30–21:30. Bathroom reset. Draft — not a reservation.
blocks.label: Gelato — Fatamorgana

blocks.what: Easy add-ons if energy remains: Circus Maximus viewpoint, or San Clemente (layered church—stairs; skip if toddler-weary). Otherwise slow walk through Celio park shade.
Walk or short taxi toward Testaccio (Circus Maximus side) · ~20–30 min. Do not metro back to Prati yet.

Via Giovanni Branca 88, Testaccio — the original Trapizzino. Stuffed pizza triangles and supplì; casual seats in the next room. A savory nibble after the Forum, before the pasta dinner. Official hours: Fri 12:00–1:00am. Draft — not a reservation. Skip if everyone is saving room for Flavio.
blocks.label: Trapizzino

blocks.what: Easy Testaccio wait: playground at the ex-Mattatoio / Monte Testaccio edge, or a café sit. Flavio’s kitchen is listed from 19:30 — later than the usual 5:30 family dinner.

Via di Monte Testaccio 97, Testaccio — under Monte dei Cocci. Classic Roman pasta (cacio e pepe, amatriciana) in a large osteria that can seat a family of 9. Official site: dinner 19:30–23:00 daily, so this sitting is later than other family nights. Call ahead for 9 / may need two tables. Draft suggestion — not reserved. Taxi back to Prati after. Seasonal note from other listings: Sunday dinner closed Oct–May — Friday is open.
blocks.label: Flavio al Velavevodetto

blocks.what: Taxi back to Prati (~15–25 min). Early-ish bedtime after a stone-heavy day.

days.label: Basilicas
days.title: Saturday Nov 21 — Major basilicas
days.note: Santa Maria Maggiore → maritozzo at Regoli → San Giovanni → Scala Santa → Santa Croce if energy remains. Afternoon back to Prati for a unique pasta dinner — not Il Matriciano.

blocks.what: At the Prati Airbnb after the grocery shop. Groceries for apartment breakfasts: Despar (Viale Giulio Cesare 193, near Ottaviano) and/or Mercato Rionale Prati (Piazza dell’Unità). First shop on arrival Mon Nov 16 after check-in. Draft routine — not a café reservation.
blocks.label: Apartment breakfast

blocks.what: Metro A to Termini + walk · ~25–40 min to Santa Maria Maggiore.
Santa Maria Maggiore · ~7:00am–6:45pm. Golden mosaics, Marian heart of Rome. Pushchair-friendly per official tips. Free. Summary: stand in the nave, look up at the gold, light a candle.

Via dello Statuto 60, Esquilino — two minutes from Santa Maria Maggiore. Historic pasticceria (1916) known for maritozzo con la panna; locals queue at the bar. Closed Tuesday; Saturday is open (often 7:00–19:00). Maritozzi can sell out late morning — go right after the basilica. Draft — not a reservation.
blocks.label: Maritozzo — Regoli

blocks.what: Walk Via Merulana or short Metro · ~25–35 min toward San Giovanni.
San Giovanni in Laterano · Cathedral of Rome · 7:00am–6:30pm. Huge nave, Apostle statues. Free.
Cross to Scala Santa · a few minutes.
Scala Santa · Holy Stairs (kneeling) / side stairs for walking. Nov–Mar sanctuary closes 6:30pm; afternoon climb to 6:00pm. With toddlers: brief look / side stairs.

Via Faleria 47, San Giovanni / Appio Latino, near the Lateran. Modern osteria of Roman and Lazio cooking — family-friendlier than a tiny tasting room (skip SantoPalato for 9). Call ahead for 9 / may need two tables. Draft suggestion — not reserved. Alternate: Pepe San Giovanni, Via Gallia 103 (restaurant-pizzeria near the basilica).
blocks.label: Osteria Faleria

blocks.what: Santa Croce in Gerusalemme · Daily 7:30am–7:00pm. Relic chapel may be closed for renovation—check before going. Short stop.
Café sit near the Lateran. Reset before the ride home.
Metro back to Prati · ~30–45 min.
Apartment downtime, laundry, easy play. Cacio e Pepe’s kitchen is listed from 19:30 — later than the usual 5:30 family dinner.

Via Giuseppe Avezzana 11, Prati (Piazza Mazzini side — walkable from the apartment). Neighborhood trattoria famous for cacio e pepe and other Roman pastas. Compact rooms — call ahead for 9 / may need two tables. Draft suggestion — not reserved. Closed Sunday; Saturday dinner listings 19:30–23:30, so this sitting is later than a 5:30 family dinner. Alternate if you still have energy on the Celio side after the basilicas: Li Rioni, Via dei Santi Quattro 24 (Roman pizza, dinner only, closed Tuesday). Not Il Matriciano.
blocks.label: Cacio e Pepe

blocks.what: Bedtime.

days.label: Mass
days.title: Sunday Nov 22 — Mass & Tiber Island
days.note: Worship first, then Ghetto lunch (Jewish-Roman), a pizza-ebraica bakery stop, Tiber Island, and gelato on the Trastevere edge. Vatican Museums closed today under the standing Sunday rule.

blocks.what: At the Prati Airbnb after the grocery shop. Groceries for apartment breakfasts: Despar (Viale Giulio Cesare 193, near Ottaviano) and/or Mercato Rionale Prati (Piazza dell’Unità). First shop on arrival Mon Nov 16 after check-in. Draft routine — not a café reservation.
blocks.label: Apartment breakfast

blocks.what: Walk to St Peter’s for Mass, or a Prati parish if easier with the baby · 20–30 min to the basilica.
St Peter’s or local parish · Confirm week-of Mass times. Sit through Mass; light tour only if kids are still game.
Coffee / pastry near the church.
Taxi to the Jewish Ghetto / Tiber Island edge · ~15–25 min. Prefer taxi over long cobbles.

Via del Portico d’Ottavia 1, Jewish Ghetto — no sign; look for the line. Historic kosher bakery (pizza ebraica, ricotta crostate). Closed Saturday; Sunday listed 7:30–17:30. Often sells out by late morning — if the line is long or the trays are empty, skip and go to lunch. Cash is commonly needed. Draft — not a reservation.
blocks.label: Pizza ebraica — Boccione

blocks.what: Piazza delle Cinque Scole 28, Jewish Ghetto — a short walk from Boccione and Tiber Island. Historic Roman trattoria (family-run since 1928); this is the Jewish-Roman table (carciofi alla giudia when in season). Official site: Sunday lunch 12:30–15:30 (no Sunday dinner); closed Tuesday. Call ahead for 9 / may need two tables. Draft suggestion — not reserved. Da Enzo al 29 is too small for 9.
blocks.label: Al Pompiere

blocks.what: Isola Tiberina & San Bartolomeo · Island stroll + brief church peek (usually morning and late-afternoon windows). Short edge of Trastevere only—cobbles are hard with a stroller.

Via della Lungaretta 96, Trastevere — a short walk from the island’s Trastevere edge. Artisanal gelato and chocolate; not a piazza tourist window. Official site: daily 8:00–midnight. Draft — not a reservation.
blocks.label: Gelato — Fior di Luna

blocks.what: Taxi back to Prati.
Apartment free time.

Via Germanico 58/60, Prati — walkable from the apartment. Tuscan trattoria (bistecca, pappardelle) that locals use near the Vatican; not a laminated piazza menu. Official site: open Tuesday–Sunday, closed Monday; dinner kitchen 20:00–23:15, so this is later than other family nights — bottles/leftovers at the apartment for the baby if 20:00 is too late. Call ahead for 9 / may need two tables. Draft suggestion — not reserved.
blocks.label: Dal Toscano

blocks.what: Quiet Sunday night. Lights toward bed — airport morning is Tuesday.

days.label: Spare
days.title: Monday Nov 23 — Spare day & pack
days.note: Default: pack, one last outing if wanted. San Paolo or Appian catacombs only if older kids insist—and only half the group. Last sit-down is a casual Prati osteria — not Il Matriciano. Pizza al taglio was Thursday at Pizzarium.

blocks.what: At the Prati Airbnb after the grocery shop. Groceries for apartment breakfasts: Despar (Viale Giulio Cesare 193, near Ottaviano) and/or Mercato Rionale Prati (Piazza dell’Unità). First shop on arrival Mon Nov 16 after check-in. Draft routine — not a café reservation.
blocks.label: Apartment breakfast

blocks.what: Pack bags, confirm tomorrow’s airport van, finish laundry.

Option A (default): Prati playground / Via Cola di Rienzo.Option B (half group): San Paolo fuori le Mura or Appian catacombs if the 9- and 7-year-olds insist. Catacombs are a poor stroller fit—adults + older kids only.
At or near the apartment from leftover groceries. Skip a restaurant lunch today. Draft — not a booking.
blocks.label: Apartment lunch

blocks.what: Last easy Rome time: river walk, gelato, or leftover church from the friend’s list near Prati. Keep it close—early airport morning tomorrow.
Final pack, stage stroller and passports by the door.

Via Giovanni Bettolo 24–32, Prati — walkable from the apartment. Casual Roman osteria (pasta, football memorabilia, locals). Closed Sunday; Monday dinner listings 19:30–23:00, so this sitting is later than a 5:30 family dinner — ask for the earliest table. Call ahead for 9 / may need two tables. Draft suggestion — not reserved. Not Il Matriciano. Lights-out after for the airport morning.
blocks.label: Osteria dell’Angelo

blocks.what: Kids asleep. Adults finish bags.

days.label: Fly home
days.title: Tuesday Nov 24 — Fly home
days.note: Airport only. AZ 618 departs FCO 10:10am. Leave Prati by ~6:00am in a pre-booked van.

blocks.what: Wake the household. Quick breakfast / bottles at the apartment from leftover groceries. No café stop. Groceries for apartment breakfasts: Despar (Viale Giulio Cesare 193, near Ottaviano) and/or Mercato Rionale Prati (Piazza dell’Unità). First shop on arrival Mon Nov 16 after check-in.
blocks.label: Apartment breakfast

blocks.what: Load van. Passports, tickets, stroller.
Prati → FCO · leave by 6:00 · 35–75 min morning traffic · arrive ~7:15–7:45.
Fiumicino · Check-in / bags / security for nine. AZ 618 10:10am → IAD 2:30pm.
Nonstop home · ~10h 20m. No morning sightseeing.

places.name: Colosseum
places.summary: Timed entry. Standard tiers — not arena/underground. Book all nine ~30 days out.

places.name: San Giovanni in Laterano
places.summary: Cathedral of Rome. Huge nave and Apostle statues.

places.name: Scala Santa

places.name: Santa Croce in Gerusalemme

places.name: Isola Tiberina / San Bartolomeo

places.name: Glass Hostaria
places.summary: Primary anniversary dinner. Vicolo del Cinque 58, Trastevere. Closed Mon/Tue; Wed–Sun dinner ~19:00–22:30. Tasting menu €135/person drinks excluded (recheck). No table held yet.

places.name: L’Arcangelo
places.summary: Walkable Prati alternate for anniversary dinner. Via G. G. Belli 59. Lunch 13:00–14:30; dinner 20:00–23:00; Saturday dinner only; closed Sunday. Thursday dinner fits. No table held yet.

places.name: Despar Prati
places.summary: Supermarket at Viale Giulio Cesare 193, near Ottaviano. Grocery stop for apartment breakfasts.

places.name: Mercato Rionale Prati
places.summary: Neighborhood market in Piazza dell’Unità, Prati. Fruit, veg, and deli counters for the apartment.

places.name: Il Matriciano
places.summary: Classic Roman trattoria in Prati, Via dei Gracchi 55. Closed Wednesday; Sunday dinner closed.

places.name: Osteria dei Gracchi
places.summary: Neighborhood osteria at Via dei Gracchi 19, Prati. Roman cooking near Ottaviano.

places.name: Trattoria Micci
places.summary: Prati trattoria-pizzeria since 1936, Via Andrea Doria 55 a/b. Closed Monday.

places.name: La Campana
places.summary: Historic Roman restaurant (from 1518) on Vicolo della Campana, near the Pantheon. Closed Monday.

places.name: Dar Bruttone Rione Monti
places.summary: Roman cooking on Via dei Serpenti 113, Monti, near the Colosseum.

places.name: Osteria Al Vicolo 9
places.summary: Monti osteria at Vicolo dei Serpenti 9. Closed Sunday.

places.name: Osteria Faleria
places.summary: Roman/Lazio osteria near San Giovanni, Via Faleria 47. Family-friendlier than a tiny tasting room for 9.

places.name: Pepe San Giovanni
places.summary: Family-scale restaurant/pizzeria at Via Gallia 103, near the Lateran.

places.name: Al Pompiere
places.summary: Historic Roman trattoria in the Ghetto, Piazza delle Cinque Scole 28. Closed Tuesday; Sunday lunch.

places.name: Cantina Cantarini
places.summary: Roman and Marchigiana osteria at Piazza Sallustio 12 (Sallustiano, short taxi from Prati). Closed Sunday.

places.name: La Pratolina
places.summary: Neighborhood pizzeria in Prati, Via degli Scipioni 248/250. Roman-style pizza for a family table.

places.name: Flavio al Velavevodetto
places.summary: Classic Testaccio pasta osteria under Monte Testaccio, Via di Monte Testaccio 97. Large enough for a family.

places.name: Cacio e Pepe
places.summary: Roman pasta trattoria at Via Giuseppe Avezzana 11, Prati. Compact rooms — two tables likely. Closed Sunday.

places.name: Dal Toscano
places.summary: Tuscan trattoria in Prati, Via Germanico 58/60. Closed Monday. Dinner kitchen from 20:00.

places.name: Pizzarium Bonci
places.summary: Gabriele Bonci’s pizza al taglio counter, Via della Meloria 43, Prati. Standing / queue; may split the group.

places.name: Osteria dell’Angelo
places.summary: Casual Roman osteria in Prati, Via Giovanni Bettolo 24–32. Closed Sunday. Dinner listings from 19:30.

places.name: Tazza d’Oro
places.summary: Historic Roman coffee bar at Via degli Orfani 84, next to the Pantheon. Stand at the counter like locals.
places.imageAlt: The storefront of Tazza d’Oro coffee bar near the Pantheon.
places.imageCredit: Photo: lienyuan lee · CC BY 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Giolitti
places.summary: Historic gelateria at Via Uffici del Vicario 40, between the Pantheon and Trevi.
places.imageAlt: Cups of gelato at Giolitti in Rome.
places.imageCredit: Photo: Sv32000 · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Sciascia Caffè 1919
places.summary: Old-school Prati coffee at Via Fabio Massimo 1/A. Cornetto at the bar, not a tourist piazza.

places.name: Gelateria dei Gracchi
places.summary: Artisanal gelato at Via dei Gracchi 272, Prati. On the walk home from Castel Sant’Angelo.

places.name: Fatamorgana Monti
places.summary: Creative artisanal gelato at Piazza degli Zingari 5, Monti, near Via dei Serpenti.

places.name: Trapizzino Testaccio
places.summary: Original Trapizzino at Via Giovanni Branca 88, Testaccio. Supplì and stuffed pizza triangles.
places.imageAlt: A trapizzino stuffed with pollo alla cacciatora.
places.imageCredit: Photo: Diego Zitelli · CC BY 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Pasticceria Regoli
places.summary: Esquilino pastry shop since 1916, Via dello Statuto 60. Famous for maritozzo con la panna. Closed Tuesday.

places.name: Pasticceria Boccione
places.summary: No-sign kosher bakery at Via del Portico d’Ottavia 1. Pizza ebraica. Closed Saturday; Sunday until 17:30.
places.imageAlt: The no-sign storefront of Pasticceria Boccione in Rome’s Jewish Ghetto.
places.imageCredit: Photo: JSFarman · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Fior di Luna
places.summary: Artisanal gelato and chocolate at Via della Lungaretta 96, Trastevere, near the Tiber Island path.

eatLikeRomans.title: Eat like Romans
eatLikeRomans.intro: Draft ideas — not bookings. The week already covers Roman pasta, a sit-down pizza, pizza al taglio, gelato, and a Jewish-Roman lunch. If you have a spare hour, these other formats are worth tasting:
items: Jewish-Roman — carciofi alla giudia and other Ghetto classics (Sunday lunch at Al Pompiere already does this; pizza ebraica at Boccione is the sweet-side snack).
Pizza al taglio / pizza bianca — Bonci’s Pizzarium in Prati is on the plan; Forno Campo de’ Fiori (Piazza Campo de’ Fiori 22, closed Sunday) is the Centro bakers’ version if you pass the campo.
Trapizzino and supplì — Roman street snacks; Trapizzino Testaccio is on Friday before the Testaccio pasta dinner.
Regional Italian beyond Lazio — Thursday lunch at Cantina Cantarini is Marchigiana as well as Roman; Dal Toscano (Sunday) is a Tuscan table in Prati.
Esquilino international — around Piazza Vittorio / Via dell’Agricoltura, Ethiopian and other kitchens sit beside the basilicas. Optional, not a forced booking.
